audit.whatIsWrong: Karma is female but loading, report[8].t, report[9].t and report[10].t call her "his/him".
audit.why: Every third-person pronoun addresses the enemy, Karma, so it must be her/she.
audit.corrected: Swap the four instances to her/she.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[0..6].side are all the unfilled "Skill" placeholder, and the level 1-4 why text (E-poke/Q threats/full-kit/chip-margins) all describe Renata winning even though content win[0..3] say Karma wins those rows.
audit.why: packet.levelChart (Karma,Karma,Karma,Karma,Renata,Renata,Renata) matches content win[] exactly — Karma's Mantra-doubled Q/W poke wins the early lane, Renata's Hostile Takeover flips it from 6 on.
audit.corrected: Side to Karma for rows 1-4, Renata for rows 5-7; rewrite the level 1-4 whys around Inner Flame poke and the Focused Resolve root instead of Renata's own kit.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization says generic "anti-heal early into his duo's sustain" without naming what heals.
audit.why: Karma's W (Focused Resolve) heals her on the Mantra-empowered tether — naming it makes the anti-heal timing concrete.
audit.corrected: Name Focused Resolve (W) as the sustain source.
sources: ownerKit W: 'Mantra Bonus: Karma strengthens the link, healing herself'

edits.before: E-poke the pair — the missiles shield yours and bill theirs in one cast.
edits.after: Her Inner Flame poke and W root punish your walk-up before you can shield it.

edits.before: Q threats begin: the root-throw relocates whoever steps wrong.
edits.after: Her W root punishes any W-dash — she chunks first, shields after.

edits.before: Full kit: W on the carry turns even trades into insured ones — the bailout math is rude.
edits.after: Mantra doubles her Q and W — the poke war is hers outright at full kit.

edits.before: Chip the margins and bank the leverage — marked trades hit harder than their items say.
edits.after: Mantra-E shields blunt every engage you find — her cooldowns still out-trade yours.

edits.before: - Renata Glasc vs Karma - Track: Karma Focused Resolve (Tether). - Track his engage cooldown — your duo trades only when it's down. - The duo goes when Focused Resolve (Tether) is down. - The R decides fights; it doesn’t advertise them.
edits.after: - Renata Glasc vs Karma - Track: Karma Focused Resolve (Tether). - Track her engage cooldown — your duo trades only when it's down. - The duo goes when Focused Resolve (Tether) is down. - The R decides fights; it doesn’t advertise them.

edits.before: World Atlas start. Helia or Mandate line, Swiftness, Redemption paths. Add anti-heal early into his duo’s sustain.
edits.after: World Atlas start. Helia or Mandate line, Swiftness, Redemption paths. Add anti-heal — her Focused Resolve (W) heals her.

edits.before: Commit on Focused Resolve (Tether)’s cooldown, on your first item spike, and with your carry’s damage online. Make him flinch first.
edits.after: Commit on Focused Resolve (Tether)’s cooldown, on your first item spike, and with your carry’s damage online. Make her flinch first.

edits.before: Your CC plus jungler arrival decides bot — ping gank windows on his engage cooldown and hold the river bush vision.
edits.after: Your CC plus jungler arrival decides bot — ping gank windows on her engage cooldown and hold the river bush vision.

notes: Chart brought into agreement with packet.levelChart/content.win: Karma wins levels 1-4 (Mantra-doubled Q/W poke), Renata flips it from level 6 (Hostile Takeover through her shields). breakdown.*/tradeGood/tradeBad/ahead/dosFull/dontsFull were judged against the template sweep and left alone — they already name real abilities (Focused Resolve, Hostile Takeover) rather than generic filler, and the band left no further room after the pronoun and chart fixes above.
